items.name: Plateau Trail Bola
items.tldr: A limited throwing tool for slowing one pursuer.
items.details: As a Utilize action, throw the bola at one Small or Medium creature within 20 feet. It makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, to a minimum of 0. It is not Grappled, Restrained or Prone. The bola lands in the target’s space and must be recovered before reuse. It deals no damage.
items.changes: Original lesser puzzle-tool-inspired adaptation. Not Nuna’s actual named weapon, authentic Iñupiat equipment statistics, or an official GAZ14 item.
items.creative: Buy time during a retreat; it does not stop a creature from attacking or teleporting.
items.flavor: Built for a journey whose map is still unfinished.
items.source_note: Official Never Alone page attests a bola. The Atruaghin placement and every rule here are new fictional project choices.

items.name: Highland Runner’s Sandals
items.tldr: A brief burst of sure-footed travel.
items.details: Requires attunement. Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action, ignore Difficult Terrain caused by loose natural stones and shallow mud until the end of your turn. Your Speed does not increase, and this does not ignore damaging terrain, magical restraints, climbing checks or liquid deep enough to require swimming.
items.changes: Original travel-themed invention; not an attested Mulaka item or a Rarámuri ceremonial object.
items.creative: Cross an uneven stretch while keeping your action for another task.
items.flavor: Built for a journey whose map is still unfinished.
items.source_note: Mulaka supplies terrain/travel inspiration only. No source-game item name or real cultural artifact is being claimed.

items.name: River Companions’ Line
items.tldr: A shared rope for deliberate river crossings.
items.details: Uses the 2024 Rope rules. Markings let companions agree on hand signals before crossing. It grants no Swim Speed, automatic rescue, special knot strength or immunity to currents; the DM resolves checks normally.
items.changes: Original cooperation-themed gear inspired by a creator-described travel game; not a documented Anishinaabe artifact or source-game item.
items.creative: Agree on a release signal before entering moving water. In play, terrain and party choices remain consequential.
items.flavor: Built for a journey whose map is still unfinished.
items.source_note: When Rivers Were Trails supplies cooperation and travel themes only, not this item’s identity or rules.

items.name: Alphatian Librarian’s Robe (Lesser)
items.tldr: Consult one previously catalogued page at a distance.
items.details: Requires attunement. During a Long Rest, touch and designate one nonmagical book you own as your reference book. Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action while wearing the robe, view a mental image of one page you have previously seen in that book, provided the book remains on the same plane. The image lasts 1 minute. It cannot show changed text, decipher a language, copy a spell into a spellbook, or cast a spell. Designating another book ends the old link.
items.changes: Independent lesser design replaces fan-described broad remote library access with one familiar page. It does not certify the item as canonical Dawn of the Emperors content.
items.creative: Recall a map legend while exploring; a new page or hidden alteration still requires visiting the book.
items.flavor: Built for a journey whose map is still unfinished.
items.source_note: Selected fan reference or thematic inspiration; original book pages and canonical powers remain unverified.

items.name: Alphatian Message Mirror (Lesser)
items.tldr: Send a short magical message once per day.
items.details: Requires attunement. Once per Long Rest, while holding this mirror, cast Message without components or a spell slot, using its normal casting time, range and all other limits. The recipient is not compelled to answer. This does not create a permanent paired-mirror connection or transmit images.
items.changes: Original lesser spell-based version of a fan-index messaging mirror; no unlimited remote surveillance.
items.creative: Whisper a brief warning through an ordinary barrier within the spell’s limits.
items.flavor: Built for a journey whose map is still unfinished.
items.source_note: Selected fan reference or thematic inspiration; original book pages and canonical powers remain unverified.

items.name: Skyfarer’s Safety Tether
items.tldr: A one-use magical arrest can stop a deck fall.
items.details: Requires attunement. Once per Long Rest, when you fall within 30 feet of a fixed anchor to which the tether is secured, use your Reaction to halt the fall at the tether’s full length, taking no damage from that fall. You remain suspended and cannot move beyond the tether. It supports only you and your carried equipment. Securing or releasing it requires a Utilize action. It cannot anchor to a held object, creature or another tether.
items.changes: Original skyship safety device inspired by expedition play; not a verified Champions of Mystara item.
items.creative: Secure the anchor before climbing the rigging. A severed or unsecured line cannot help.
items.flavor: Built for a journey whose map is still unfinished.
items.source_note: Selected fan reference or thematic inspiration; original book pages and canonical powers remain unverified.

items.name: Alphatian Courier Skyship
items.tldr: An original crewed skyship proposal for expedition campaigns.
items.details: Original 2024 vehicle proposal, requiring DM approval. Flying Speed 30 feet while at least 6 trained crew work aboard; maximum 8 passengers in addition to crew and 2 tons of cargo. No space travel, plane travel, hover when uncrewed, or automatic weapon systems. In combat, one helmsman uses an action to direct the vessel’s movement on their turn; it moves only once per round and grants no extra creature actions. Damage, collisions, adverse weather and loss of propulsion require agreed vehicle rules before use.
items.changes: Independent lower-power ship template. Not the Princess Ark’s canonical statistics or a complete Champions skyship-building rules conversion.
items.creative: Use as a mobile expedition base; crew, supplies, mooring rights and dangerous weather create ongoing needs.
items.flavor: Built for a journey whose map is still unfinished.
items.source_note: Selected fan reference or thematic inspiration; original book pages and canonical powers remain unverified.
